sloka: लतागृहैश्चित्रगृहैश्च नाशितैर्महोरगैर्व्यालमृगैश्च निर्धुतैः ।शिलागृहैरुन्मथितैस्तथा गृहैः प्रनष्टरूपं तदभून्महद्वनम् ।। ५.४१.१९।।।।
transliteration: latāgṛhaiścitragṛhaiśca nāśitairmahoragairvyālamṛgaiśca nirdhutaiḥ ।śilāgṛhairunmathitaistathā gṛhaiḥ pranaṣṭarūpaṁ tadabhūnmahadvanam ।। 5.41.19।।।।

translations.english: The great garden lay disfigured, with the arbours and the picture galleries ruined, huge serpents and wild animals scattered, with stone houses and sheds destroyed.
